question: Who among the following received the ’ASSOCHAM Enterprise of the Century Award’ in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratan Tata**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratan Tata is an Indian industrialist and a former chairman of Tata Sons**__.

 __
 
• Ratan Tata received the ’**ASSOCHAM Enterprise of the Century Award**’ in December 2020.

 
 
• He received the prestigious award on behalf of the **Tata Group.**
 
• The award is to mark the contribution of the business group to India's progress.
 
• The award was presented by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• From December 15 to 19, 2020, the Associated Chambers of Commerce of India (ASSOCHAM) Foundation Week was held.
 
 
 
• He was honoured with the **Padma Bhushan **in 2000.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan **in 2008.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• In 1920,** ASSOCHAM **was founded by promoter Chambers representing all of India's provinces.

 
 
• ASSOCHAM represents over 400 chambers and trade organizations.
 
• It has a membership of about 4.5 lakh people in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiv Nadar** is the founder and chairman of HCL Technologies Limited.
 
• **Mukesh Ambani **is the chairman and managing director of Reliance Industries Ltd.
 
• **Azim Premji **is the founder chairman of Wipro
